caption:
And We have already created man and know what his soul whispers to him, and We are closer to him than [his] jugular vein.

Surah Qaf (50:16). Swipe through for the Arabic, then English, Mandarin, Korean and Japanese renderings.

Sources on the final slide.

#Quran #IslamicReminder #Ayah #Deen #IslamicGuidance

sourcing.arabic: Uthmani script (quran-uthmani), api.alquran.cloud. Two independent live fetches this session (2026-11-14) of GET /v1/ayah/50:16/editions/quran-uthmani,en.sahih,zh.jian,ko.korean,ja.japanese, HTTP 200 each, diffed: byte-identical. Verbatim: "وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ وَنَعْلَمُ مَا تُوَسْوِسُ بِهِۦ نَفْسُهُۥ ۖ وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ ٱلْوَرِيدِ"
sourcing.english: Saheeh International (en.sahih). Verbatim: "And We have already created man and know what his soul whispers to him, and We are closer to him than [his] jugular vein"
sourcing.chinese: Ma Jian (zh.jian). Verbatim: "我确已创造人，我知道他心中的妄想；我比他的命脉还近于他。"
sourcing.korean: ko.korean; source metadata lists translator as 'Unknown', credited on-slide as not specified. Raw: "하나님은 인간을 창조하사 인간의 마음속에 속삭이고 있는 것을 알고 있으며 인간의 목에 있 는 혈관보다 내가 더 인간에게 가 까이 있노라". Spacing-only fixes: '있 는' -> '있는'; '가 까이' -> '가까이'. Whitespace-stripped text verified identical to raw. No wording changed.
sourcing.japanese: ja.japanese; source metadata lists translator as 'Unknown', cited as such. Verbatim: "本当にわれは人間を創った。そしてその魂が囁くことも知っている。われは（人間の）脛動脈よりも人間に近いのである。"
sourcing.verification_note: All renderings from two live api.alquran.cloud fetches this session, diffed identical; none from memory. Manual halal compliance check against scripts/data/compliance-policy.json blocklists: typography only, no imagery. Dupcheck against local daily/*/blankdiscussions meta files: quran:50:16 NEW (only 50:9 reel exists from surah 50; different ayah).
